kind: other
depth: focused
-- base/main.tf --
resource "aws_pipes_pipe" "this" {
  for_each = var.pipes
  name     = each.key
  role_arn = "arn"
  source   = "arn:source"
  target   = "arn:target"

  dynamic "target_parameters" {
    for_each = try([each.value.target_parameters], [])

    content {
      dynamic "eventbridge_event_bus_parameters" {
        for_each = try([target_parameters.value.bus], [])

        content {
          source = try(eventbridge_event_bus_parameters.value.source, null)
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

resource "aws_sqs_queue" "this" {
  name                      = "q"
  message_retention_seconds = 60
}

variable "pipes" {
  type = any
}
